# Next Level Construct, LLC

> Licensed general contractor based in Essington, Delaware County, Pennsylvania, serving Pennsylvania, Delaware and South Jersey. Phone (215) 980-0195. Rated 5.0 on Google from 15 reviews.

Licenses: PA HIC #PA201433, DE #2026700487, NJ HIC #13VH14325000. Fully insured. Free written estimates.

## Main services

- [Decks and railings](https://www.next-level-construct.com/decks.html): new decks, rebuilds, composite decking, railing replacement
- [All services](https://www.next-level-construct.com/services.html): kitchens, bathrooms, additions, whole-home and basement remodeling, finish carpentry, siding, HOA exterior work
